inspection_method: All four final PNGs opened with view_image and examined by the author.

observations.overview: Full site is framed; station, curved platform/rail, hills, conifers and loop path are visible.
observations.top_down: Actual overhead view frames the complete 100m square; station/rail/path layout is legible.
observations.platform: Teal siding, windows, canopy, benches, luggage, planters and lamps are visible; 01 and ALDER PASS text read correctly.
observations.tracks: Rails and sleepers lead into a masonry arch with readable 1908; the short tunnel interior terminates in a deliberately dark backing.

limitations: The common overview camera presents the tunnel obliquely; the tracks detail supplies the frontal view.
Some paths have angular seams and the distant terrain is sparsely detailed.
The tunnel and canopy shadows are deep; interiors are visual shells.
